name: spellkave_define_niche
label: Define Niche (verb)
description: Author ONE niche_definitions row (+ niche_definition_tag satellites, + spatial_niche_attachments binding it to place nodes/edges) in a single call. Self-scaffolds the [[bundles]] header if `bundle` has none yet. NOTE: an attachment referencing a BOOTSTRAP-seeded niche (one with no niche_definitions row of its own in any bundle, e.g. core's 'core/passable_portal') cannot be authored through THIS verb (it always emits a niche_definitions parent row) — use spellkave_write_rows for a standalone spatial_niche_attachments row in that case. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the row + EVERY satellite wholesale (fewer tags/attachments on a re-run means the stale ones are gone, not left behind).

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on every generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

display_name.description: niche_definitions.display_name. Omit to derive a title-cased `id` (#1968 smart default).

description.description: niche_definitions.description — REQUIRED (unlike every OTHER verb's optional `description?`): NicheDefinitionRow kept its own PRE-EXISTING required description column through the #1968 description-column decision (no `#[serde(default)]` in the schema); omitting it would author an invalid row, not merely a less-documented one.

predicate_source.description: DSL Bool predicate (default '' = trivially-true, matches any candidate target).

node.description: spatial_niche_attachments.place_node_id — an authored place_node id. EXACTLY ONE of `node`/`edge` must be set per attachment (the two authored attachment shapes the corpus actually uses).

edge.description: spatial_niche_attachments.place_edge_id — a place_edge numeric id (0 is the SpacetimeDB 'every edge' wildcard convention, e.g. a global passable-portal gate). EXACTLY ONE of `node`/`edge`.

attachments.description: spatial_niche_attachments rows binding this niche to place nodes/edges.
